title: Image Preprocessing & Data Augmentation
interviewAnswer: Image preprocessing standardizes model inputs; augmentation creates plausible label-preserving variation to improve generalization. Augmentations must respect task semantics—horizontal flips are not universally valid.
keyPoints: Validation/test data should not receive stochastic training augmentation.
why: Image Preprocessing & Data Augmentation is a standard part of a broad data/ML curriculum because it changes how models are selected, evaluated or operated in real systems.
deepDive: Image preprocessing standardizes model inputs; augmentation creates plausible label-preserving variation to improve generalization. Augmentations must respect task semantics—horizontal flips are not universally valid. Geometric/color transforms have domain assumptions. Validation/test data should not receive stochastic training augmentation. A strong answer connects the formal idea to validation, data requirements and failure modes instead of treating the method as a recipe.
workedExample: Use crop/color jitter for natural-image classification but avoid flips if left/right orientation carries medical meaning.
commonMistakes: Choosing the technique without checking whether its assumptions match the problem.
Optimizing an offline metric without checking realistic validation slices or operational constraints.
followUps: When would you not use Image Preprocessing & Data Augmentation?
How would you validate or tune Image Preprocessing & Data Augmentation?
production: In production, validate on realistic slices, track latency/cost when relevant, and monitor for distribution changes or failure modes that the offline metric can hide.
